relationships.subject: miR-16
relationships.evidence_quote: It has been reported that miR-16 targets and inhibits TLR4 in the LPS-induced inflammatory pathway

key_findings: Scoping review of 40 studies: TLR4 is upregulated in most IBS patient cohorts (11/13) and acts mainly via TLR4/MyD88/NF-kB to drive inflammation, visceral hypersensitivity, barrier damage and dysbiosis.
Acupuncture, herbs, probiotics and other treatments improve IBS by inhibiting TLR4 and related pathways including TLR4/NF-kB/NLRP3.
